others.route: Viză de lungă şedere pentru angajare în muncă şi permis unic

note: Romania: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). A third-country national performer is employed on a long-stay visa for employment and then a single permit; an artist working in a Romanian cultural institution on the Culture Minister's order has the employer's single request on the WorkinRomania platform (OUG 194/2002 arts. 24(1)(d) and 27^1(1)(c), in the consolidated form valid from 27 April 2026, as amended by OUG 32/2026, which repealed OG 25/2014). Neither names days a performer may work without it, so none are modelled. Read from the Immigration Inspectorate's copies, since legislatie.just.ro refuses this client.

sources.title: Inspectoratul General pentru Imigrări, OUG nr. 32/2026 privind accesul străinilor pe piaţa muncii din România
